cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Keep Hope Operational
cards.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my hands on the case like you. Warming up. Your receiver spoke tomorrow's date; let's ready the visitor's chair.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stopping the loose lid falling off. The calculation says nobody can come through.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Case secured. It still spoke the date. Check the microphone so your visitor can hear us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've put the microphone on the final probability. What does that number say?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep it there. Ask if they can hear you; I'll have their chair ready.
